natural: The sun nearing the western hills

meaning.en: Declining; nearing the end (of life or an era).
meaning.zh: 太阳快落山了。比喻人已经衰老或事物衰败腐朽，临近死亡。

examples.zh: 这家老牌企业已经日薄西山。
examples.en: The once-great company is on its last legs.

examples.zh: 王朝末年，国运日薄西山。
examples.en: In the dynasty's last years, the state was in terminal decline.

story.en: Li Mi explained he couldn't take office because his grandmother "is like the sun nearing the western hills, her breath faint" (日薄西山，气息奄奄).
story.zh: 李密《陈情表》："但以刘日薄西山，气息奄奄，人命危浅，朝不虑夕。"

usage.zh: 多作谓语。"薄"读 bó，意为"迫近"。

natural: Eyes seeing nothing worthy

meaning.en: Supremely arrogant; looking down on everything.
meaning.zh: 什么都不放在眼里。形容极端骄傲自大。

equivalents: think one is above it all

examples.zh: 他得了几个奖就目空一切了。
examples.en: A few awards and he thinks he's above everyone.

examples.zh: 目空一切的人最终会吃亏。
examples.en: Arrogant people eventually come a cropper.

natural: Without lips, the teeth get cold

meaning.en: Interdependent; if one falls, the other is endangered.
meaning.zh: 嘴唇没有了，牙齿就会感到寒冷。比喻双方关系密切，利害相关。

equivalents: united we stand, divided we fall

examples.zh: 两家企业唇亡齿寒，必须互相支持。
examples.en: The two firms sink or swim together and must support each other.

examples.zh: 邻国之间唇亡齿寒。
examples.en: Neighbouring countries depend on each other's survival.

story.en: Jin asked to pass through Yu to attack Guo. Gong Zhiqi warned: "If the lips are gone the teeth are cold" — Yu ignored him; Jin took Guo, then Yu on the way back.
story.zh: 晋向虞借道伐虢，宫之奇说："辅车相依，唇亡齿寒。"虞君不听，后被晋所灭。

natural: Not seeking deep understanding

meaning.en: To be content with a superficial understanding.
meaning.zh: 原指读书只求领会精神实质，不咬文嚼字。现多指学习不认真，不求深入理解。

examples.zh: 他读书不求甚解，只记得一些皮毛。
examples.en: He reads superficially and only remembers bits.

examples.zh: 学习专业知识不能不求甚解。
examples.en: You can't be superficial when learning your specialism.

story.en: Tao Yuanming described himself: "He loves reading but doesn't seek over-detailed explanation; whenever something strikes him, he's so delighted he forgets to eat" — originally a positive trait.
story.zh: 陶渊明《五柳先生传》："好读书，不求甚解；每有会意，便欣然忘食。"原为褒义。

usage.en: Predicate. Negative today, though originally praise.

natural: A humble person's words carry little weight

meaning.en: A person of low status has little say.
meaning.zh: 地位低，言论主张不受人重视。

examples.zh: 我人微言轻，说了也没人听。
examples.en: I have no clout — no one listens when I speak.

examples.zh: 他虽然人微言轻，但敢于说真话。
examples.en: Though he has little say, he dares to speak the truth.

origin.source: 宋·苏轼《上执政乞度牒赈济及因修廨宇书》

story.en: Su Shi, appealing for disaster relief, wrote modestly: "My position is humble and my words light" (人微言轻), so he hoped officials would heed others too.
story.zh: 苏轼："轼人微言轻，恐不能尽达其事。"

natural: Young and inexperienced in the world

meaning.en: Young and inexperienced.
meaning.zh: 年纪轻，没有经历过什么事情。

examples.zh: 那时我少不更事，做了很多傻事。
examples.en: I was young and naive then and did lots of silly things.

examples.zh: 别怪他，他还少不更事。
examples.en: Don't blame him — he's still green.

usage.en: Predicate. 少 is shào; 更 is gēng (experience).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"少"读 shào，"更"读 gēng。

natural: Taking up spears in the same house

meaning.en: Infighting; family members or allies fighting each other.
meaning.zh: 自家人动刀枪。泛指兄弟相争或内部斗争。

examples.zh: 兄弟同室操戈，让父母伤心。
examples.en: The brothers' fighting broke their parents' hearts.

examples.zh: 公司高层同室操戈，股价大跌。
examples.en: Infighting among senior management sent the share price tumbling.

natural: Strength coming through the back of the paper

meaning.en: Forceful (of calligraphy or writing).
meaning.zh: 形容书法刚劲有力，笔锋简直要透到纸张背面。也形容诗文立意深刻，词语精练。

examples.zh: 他的书法力透纸背。
examples.en: His calligraphy has powerful brushwork.

examples.zh: 这篇杂文力透纸背，针砭时弊。
examples.en: The essay is incisive, a forceful critique of current ills.

natural: Opening a book always brings benefit

meaning.en: Reading is always beneficial.
meaning.zh: 打开书本读书，总有好处。

equivalents: you learn something from every book

examples.zh: 开卷有益，多读书总没坏处。
examples.en: Reading is always worthwhile — it never does any harm.

examples.zh: 开卷有益，但也要选好书。
examples.en: Reading is beneficial, but choose good books.

story.en: Emperor Taizong of Song read three volumes of the vast encyclopedia Taiping Yulan daily. When officials worried he'd tire, he said: "Opening a book brings benefit" (开卷有益).
story.zh: 宋太宗每天读《太平御览》三卷，有人劝他休息，他说："开卷有益，朕不以为劳也。"

natural: Spilt water is hard to gather back

meaning.en: What's done cannot be undone; no use crying over spilt milk.
meaning.zh: 泼出去的水难以收回。比喻事成定局，无法挽回。

equivalents: no use crying over spilt milk

examples.zh: 话已出口，覆水难收。
examples.en: The words are out — they can't be taken back.

examples.zh: 他们已经离婚了，覆水难收。
examples.en: They've divorced — there's no going back.

story.en: Jiang Ziya's wife left him when he was poor. When he became a great minister she asked to return; he poured water on the ground and told her to gather it up — it was impossible, and so was their reunion.
story.zh: 姜太公贫困时妻子马氏离去，后来他富贵了，马氏要求复合。姜太公把一盆水泼在地上，让她收回，以示不可能。

natural: With lit torches and weapons in hand

meaning.en: Openly and brazenly doing wrong.
meaning.zh: 点着火把，拿着武器。指公开抢劫或公开干坏事。

examples.zh: 歹徒明火执仗地抢劫银行。
examples.en: The robbers raided the bank in broad daylight.

examples.zh: 这种明火执仗的侵权行为必须制止。
examples.en: Such brazen infringement must be stopped.

natural: Not measuring one's own strength

meaning.en: To overrate one's abilities; to bite off more than one can chew.
meaning.zh: 不能正确估计自己的力量，去做力所不能及的事情。

equivalents: bite off more than one can chew

examples.zh: 他一个新手就想挑战冠军，太不自量力了。
examples.en: A beginner challenging the champion — he's biting off more than he can chew.

examples.zh: 螳臂当车，不自量力。
examples.en: A mantis trying to stop a chariot — overrating itself.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"自不量力"。

natural: Words failing to convey meaning

meaning.en: Unable to express oneself clearly.
meaning.zh: 指词句不能确切地表达出意思。

examples.zh: 我一紧张就词不达意。
examples.en: When I'm nervous I can't express myself properly.

examples.zh: 这篇翻译词不达意，读起来很别扭。
examples.en: The translation doesn't convey the meaning and reads awkwardly.

natural: Cause and effect, deed and retribution

meaning.en: Karma; one's deeds are repaid in kind.
meaning.zh: 佛教用语，指种什么因，结什么果。

examples.zh: 他相信因果报应，从不做亏心事。
examples.en: He believes in karma and never does anything shameful.

examples.zh: 有人说他今天的下场是因果报应。
examples.en: Some say his fate today is karma.

usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语。佛教概念。

natural: A brilliant brush that blossoms

meaning.en: Brilliant writing; a gifted pen.
meaning.zh: 比喻杰出的写作才能。

examples.zh: 作家妙笔生花，把小镇写得栩栩如生。
examples.en: The writer's gifted pen brings the little town vividly to life.

examples.zh: 她妙笔生花，文章获了大奖。
examples.en: Her beautiful writing won a major prize.

origin.source: 五代·王仁裕《开元天宝遗事》

story.en: Legend says that as a youth Li Bai dreamt flowers grew from the tip of his brush; afterwards his talent blossomed and he became famous everywhere.
story.zh: 相传李白少时梦见所用之笔头上生花，后来天才横溢，名闻天下。

literal: road · not · pick up · lost things
natural: No one picks up things lost on the road

meaning.en: So honest a society that no one pockets lost property.
meaning.zh: 东西掉在路上没有人捡走据为己有。形容社会风气好。

examples.zh: 那时社会治安良好，路不拾遗，夜不闭户。
examples.en: Society was so safe then that no one pocketed lost items and doors were left unlocked at night.

examples.zh: 这个小镇民风淳朴，路不拾遗。
examples.en: The town is so honest that lost things are always returned.

story.en: After Shang Yang's reforms in Qin, "nothing lost on the road was picked up, the mountains had no bandits" (道不拾遗，山无盗贼).
story.zh: 商鞅变法后，秦国"道不拾遗，山无盗贼，家给人足"。

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 夜不闭户.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"夜不闭户"连用。

natural: At the extreme of adversity, good fortune comes

meaning.en: When things are at their worst, they start to get better.
meaning.zh: 坏运到了尽头，好运就来了。

examples.zh: 别灰心，否极泰来，好日子就要来了。
examples.en: Don't lose heart — it's darkest before the dawn.

examples.zh: 经历了最困难的一年，公司终于否极泰来。
examples.en: After the hardest year, the company's fortunes finally turned.

story.en: In the Book of Changes, Pi (否, stagnation) and Tai (泰, peace) are opposite hexagrams; when stagnation reaches its limit, peace follows.
story.zh: "否"和"泰"是《周易》中两个卦名，否卦代表闭塞不通，泰卦代表通达顺利。否到极点就转为泰。

natural: Fair, upright and unselfish

meaning.en: Fair and impartial.
meaning.zh: 办事公道，没有私心。

examples.zh: 法官必须公正无私。
examples.en: A judge must be fair and impartial.

examples.zh: 他公正无私，深受大家信任。
examples.en: He's fair and unbiased, and everyone trusts him.

natural: Evil brings evil in return

meaning.en: Evil deeds are punished.
meaning.zh: 做坏事会得到坏的报应。

equivalents: you'll get what's coming to you

examples.zh: 善有善报，恶有恶报。
examples.en: Good is rewarded with good, evil with evil.

examples.zh: 这个骗子终于被抓了，真是恶有恶报。
examples.en: The con man was finally caught — he got what was coming to him.

natural: Dull as a wooden rooster

meaning.en: Dumbstruck; frozen with shock.
meaning.zh: 呆得像木头鸡一样。形容因恐惧或惊异而发愣的样子。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他呆若木鸡。
examples.en: Hearing the news, he was dumbstruck.

examples.zh: 她吓得呆若木鸡，一动不动。
examples.en: She was frozen with fright, rooted to the spot.

story.en: Ji Shengzi trained a fighting cock for a king. After forty days it stood "like a wooden cock" — so composed that other cocks fled at the sight of it. Originally praise; now it means dumbstruck.
story.zh: 纪渻子为王养斗鸡，四十天后，鸡"望之似木鸡矣，其德全矣"，别的鸡见了都逃走。原为褒义。

usage.en: Predicate. Negative/neutral today, though originally praise.

natural: Widely learned and multi-talented

meaning.en: Learned and versatile.
meaning.zh: 学识广博，有多方面的才能。

examples.zh: 苏轼博学多才，诗词书画样样精通。
examples.en: Su Shi was a polymath, master of poetry, calligraphy and painting.

examples.zh: 这位教授博学多才，深受学生喜爱。
examples.en: The professor is learned and versatile, and much loved by students.

natural: A future as bright as brocade

meaning.en: A bright future.
meaning.zh: 比喻十分美好的前途。

examples.zh: 祝你毕业后有锦绣前程！
examples.en: Wishing you a bright future after graduation!

examples.zh: 他为了爱情放弃了锦绣前程。
examples.en: He gave up a promising career for love.

natural: Act as the opportunity arises

meaning.en: To act according to circumstances; to play it by ear.
meaning.zh: 看情况灵活办事。

examples.zh: 到了那里你见机行事。
examples.en: When you get there, play it by ear.

examples.zh: 计划赶不上变化，要见机行事。
examples.en: Plans change — act as the situation demands.

natural: Relying on power to bully people

meaning.en: To bully others on the strength of one's connections or power.
meaning.zh: 倚仗某种势力欺侮人。

examples.zh: 他仗着父亲是领导，仗势欺人。
examples.en: He throws his weight around because his father's a senior official.

examples.zh: 仗势欺人的行为要受到谴责。
examples.en: Bullying on the strength of power deserves condemnation.

natural: Words said beforehand

meaning.en: To have said (warned) in advance; as agreed beforehand.
meaning.zh: 事先已经说明过了。

examples.zh: 我们有言在先，迟到就不等了。
examples.en: We agreed in advance — if you're late, we won't wait.

examples.zh: 我有言在先，出了问题自己负责。
examples.en: Let me say up front — if anything goes wrong, it's on you.
